item.title: Whiskers 0.8.37
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.37

### Bluetooth Dictation

  • Improved Bluetooth dictation startup so recording begins more promptly without the usual warm-up delay
  • Improved handling for quieter speech so soft-spoken recordings come through more reliably

    • ### Improvements

  • Added support diagnostics to make troubleshooting easier when something goes wrong

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed license removal so deactivating a machine is handled correctly
  • Improved the machine limit error message so it is clearer when you have reached your activation limit
